Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can. In that case, it would only trash that 1 digivolution card.
Card Q&A.q: Can this card's inherited effect be activated on an opponent's Digimon that only has 1 digivolution card?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Trash 2 digivolution cards at the bottom of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
